services_source: getent services <port>/tcp (TCP records) and <port>/udp (UDP records) on the oracle host
protocols_source: getent protocols <ip_proto> on the oracle host for the records that are neither TCP nor UDP

extended.note: the protocols cases were captured later with the same oracle and script; every earlier case reproduced (masked_sha256, stdout, stderr) and was kept as committed

the ipv6 cases (records of types 10/11 mixed with IPv4 records, and the IPv6 read-filter cases) were captured later with the same oracle and script; every earlier case reproduced (masked_sha256, stdout, stderr; the raw sha256 of the 26 clock-masked outputs differs by the masked fields only) and was kept as committed; the IPv6-only read filter is not captured: C ignores it (in-binary.c:254), rmasscan filters (R14)

the banner cases (records of types 9/13 mixed with status records, the legacy types 3/4/5, certs and the default format with C stdout kept as a file, --banner-types, an address and port filter on banners) were captured later with the same oracle and an extended script (walk_records reads varint types and lengths and the banner types; run_case keeps a raw stdout as a file); every earlier case reproduced (masked_sha256, stdout, stderr; the raw sha256 of the 35 clock-masked earlier outputs differs by the masked fields only) and was kept as committed
